rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when an action is done unreliably or without being securely controlled.

example.english: The brakes on my bike were faulty, so I pressed them insecurely and nearly crashed.
example.traditional: 我部單車個煞車掣壞咗，撳落去撳得唔穩陣，差啲撞車。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou6 daan1 ce1 go3 saat3 ce1 zai3 waai6 zo2 gam6 lok6 heoi3 gam6 dak1 m4 wan2 zan6 caa1 di1 zong6 ce1

rows.note: Use this specifically when the manner of doing something is physically unsafe or lacks protection.

example.english: They stood insecurely on a chair while reaching for something, so I immediately told them to come down.
example.traditional: 佢企喺張凳上面拎嘢，企得唔安全，我即刻叫佢落返嚟。
example.jyutping: keoi5 kei5 hai2 zoeng1 dang3 soeng6 min6 ling1 je5 kei5 dak1 m4 on1 cyun4 ngo5 zik1 hak1 giu3 keoi5 lok6 faan1 lai4

rows.note: Use this when “insecurely” describes someone acting or speaking without self-confidence.

example.english: I spoke insecurely the first time I went on stage, as if I were reciting from memory.
example.traditional: 我第一次上台講嘢，講得冇自信，好似背書咁。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 soeng5 toi1 gong2 je5 gong2 dak1 mou5 zi6 seon3 hou2 ci5 bui6 syu1 gam3
